title: Nora's 9 Subscriptions Cost $1,700 a Year

scenes.say: Nora pays for 9 subscriptions, and every single one feels tiny.
Music is $12. A news app, $10. Cloud storage, $3.
Then the big ones. A $45 gym she visits twice a month, plus two apps at $15 and $13.
Add it all up, and it's about $142, every month.
Over a year, that's roughly $1,700. Gone in small bites.
So she did a one-hour audit. Keep one streamer, rotate the others, and switch to a $10 gym.
The news app and the language app? Cancelled. She hadn't opened them since spring.
Her new total is about $71 a month. Same shows, same music.
That's about $850 a year back, without losing anything she actually uses.
How many subscriptions do you pay for? Count them. Nora thought it was 4. It was 9 apps, at $142 a month.
